children: The S&P 500 Energy sector is poised for a strong third quarter, with earnings expected to grow 114% year-over-year, the highest among all 11 sectors.

Higher oil prices are a key driver, with average crude prices rising 32% year-over-year to $85.68 per barrel. Energy has also seen the largest upward revision in earnings estimates since the start of the quarter, with projected earnings increasing 19.4% to $56.1B.
The sector’s share price has climbed 18.7% since June 30, reflecting improving earnings expectations. At the company level, Marathon Petroleum
have seen significant upward revisions to their earnings estimates, making them key contributors to the sector’s improved outlook.

Revenue growth is also expected to remain robust at 21.4%, the second-highest among S&P 500 sectors. All five Energy sub-industries are projected to report year-over-year revenue growth, while refining and marketing leads earnings growth expectations with a projected 431% increase.
has advanced 16.5% between July and September end, while the broader S&P 500 gained by a little over 2%.
